brain_sources.title: Ben → Shirley, March 2024 — Taipei vendor preference
brain_sources.snippet: AC at Taipei — always Mr. Wang first. Mandarin OK. Around $80 emergency call. Don't auth over $200 without warranty check.

brain_sources.title: HVAC Leak & Electrical Safety Protocol
brain_sources.snippet: Power down unit if safe. Dispatch HVAC + electrician combo vendor. Authorize emergency diagnostic up to $200.

brain_sources.title: April 2024 — AC leak, Warm Taipei
brain_sources.snippet: Mr. Wang HVAC, 2.1hr to resolve, $145 total. Outcome: 5-star.

resolution.guest_response: Acknowledged, AC off, will use living room unit until vendor arrives.

proposed_rule.title: Auto-escalate Taipei HVAC + electrical risk if Mr. Wang unavailable
proposed_rule.description: Pattern detected: HVAC tickets at Taipei with electrical risk now consistently route to Mr. Wang within 2hrs. When Mr. Wang is unavailable, auto-escalate to manager rather than fall back to a cheaper same-day vendor.
proposed_rule.rationale: Mr. Wang's electrical-safety judgement is the moat. Falling back to a cheaper vendor without it has caused two near-misses. Escalation cost is lower than insurance exposure.
proposed_rule.lightsprint_prompt: Add a comp_rule.py automation: when an hvac_leak ticket at a Taipei property has risk_tags including 'electrical_risk' AND the preferred vendor (mr_wang_hvac) is unavailable, escalate to manager instead of selecting a fallback vendor. Post a Slack notification to #ops-ben. Tag the LLM call with metadata.property_id, metadata.ticket_id, and metadata.tier='strong' so it shows up in the TokenRouter cost ticker correctly.
